bounded_time.mechanism: outer timeout -k 1s <remaining+2>s process-group watchdog (own PG, never --foreground) around the unchanged body; fresh remaining per op + timeout -k kill-after inside
bounded_time.proven_dynamically: whole-script startup SYNC + loop SYNC/CP stall and TERM-ignore runs expire with EXPIRED/0 and no orphan logger children
bounded_time.honesty_note: best-effort, NOT hard realtime: 1s resolution + 2s drain + 1s KILL + ~1s scheduler; D-state/sync may exceed

runtime_closure.testonly: unshare+mount are TESTONLY for private-mount/kmsg isolation, NOT production
runtime_closure.pack_need: integrator must ensure timeout(coreutils)+python3 in the live image (frozen SFS carries both); no new installed helper is used, the watchdog is inline in kestrel-root-log.sh
